"""RoboPaint 口: camera-based brush calibration and three-stroke execution.
All robot motion is logged as tip targets under /app/output/actions.
Run interactively; completed actions are recorded in the JSONL manifest.
"""
import sys,json,time,pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); (OUT/'actions').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['scene_cam','canvas_cam','practice_cam','side_cam'],depth=True)
quat=obs.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[3:].copy()
surface=0.0202011 # measured in initial downward depth cameras
last_target=obs.group('tcp_pose',now=True).copy()
counter=len(list((OUT/'actions').glob('*.npy')))
def save(res,name):
    folder=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')/name
    res.save(str(folder))
    for c,a in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(folder/(c+'.png'))
    return res

def inspect(name='inspect',depth=True):
    global obs
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=depth)
    save(obs,name)
    print('OBS',name,'tip',obs.group('tcp_pose',now=True).round(6).tolist(),'time_left',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return obs

def execute(a,name='move',dt=.05,cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'),fps=10):
    global counter,last_target,obs
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float)
    if a.shape[1]==3: a=np.c_[a,np.tile(quat,(len(a),1))]
    counter+=1
    fn=OUT/'actions'/f'{counter:03d}_{name}.npy'; np.save(fn,a)
    before=r.status()
    with (OUT/'manifest.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'file':str(fn),'name':name,'dt':dt,'before':before,'state':'sent'})+'\n')
    try: res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=dt,cameras=cameras,video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=name)
    except Exception:
        print('ERROR',r.wait_ready(),flush=True)
        raise
    save(res,f'{counter:03d}_{name}')
    last_target=a[-1].copy(); obs=res
    with (OUT/'manifest.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps({'file':str(fn),'state':'completed','control_steps':res.meta.get('control_steps')})+'\n')
    print('EXEC',counter,name,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps'),'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True).round(6).tolist(),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'time_left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return res

def line(a,b,seconds):
    n=max(1,int(round(seconds/.05)))
    return np.linspace(np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b),n+1)[1:]

def go(x,y,z,seconds=2,name='move',hold=.5):
    p=np.array([x,y,z]); a=line(last_target[:3],p,seconds)
    if hold: a=np.r_[a,np.tile(p,(int(round(hold/.05)),1))]
    return execute(a,name)

def park(name='park'):
    p=last_target[:3].copy(); p[2]=.10
    a=line(last_target[:3],p,1)
    b=np.array([-.10,.24,.10]); a=np.r_[a,line(p,b,3),np.tile(b,(10,1))]
    return execute(a,name,cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'])

def pixel_world(u,v,z=surface):
    return np.array([-.1+(511.5-v)*.227185/1024,(511.5-u)*.227185/1024,z])

save(obs,'session_start')
print('READY',last_target.tolist(),flush=True)

"""Compare only camera RGB with the target; no sheet or brush state access."""
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates,distance_transform_edt,binary_erosion,shift
MM=.227185/1024*1000
TARGET=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100

def rectify(path,cam='canvas_cam',offset=(0,0)):
    im=np.asarray(Image.open(path)).astype(float)
    v,u=np.indices((1024,1024));x=-.1+(511.5-v)*MM/1000+offset[0];y=(511.5-u)*MM/1000+offset[1]
    if cam=='canvas_cam': k=2344.588379/(.62-.0202011);pu=512-k*y;pv=512-k*(x+.1)
    else: k=1834.508057/(.47-.0202011);pu=256-k*(y+.1856);pv=512-k*(x+.1)
    out=np.stack([map_coordinates(im[:,:,i],[pv,pu],order=1,mode='constant',cval=240) for i in range(3)],2)
    return out

def measures(ink,target=TARGET):
    inter=(ink&target).sum();union=(ink|target).sum()
    db=distance_transform_edt(~target);stray=(ink&(db>1/MM)).sum()/target.sum()
    be=ink&~binary_erosion(ink);bt=target&~binary_erosion(target)
    dt=distance_transform_edt(~bt);di=distance_transform_edt(~be)
    precision=(dt[be]<=1/MM).mean(); recall=(di[bt]<=1/MM).mean()
    f=2*precision*recall/(precision+recall) if precision+recall else 0
    return {'iou':inter/union,'coverage':inter/target.sum(),'stray':stray,'boundary_f':f,'area_ratio':ink.sum()/target.sum()}

if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    rgb=rectify(sys.argv[1]);Image.fromarray(rgb.astype('uint8')).save('/app/output/rectified.png');ink=rgb.mean(2)<100
    print(measures(ink))
